I haven't saved the draft yet because it needs approval first. A per-seat rate counts as a finance figure, and only Anselm (CFO), June (deal desk) and the account owner can receive those. Owning the account lets you see the rate, but it doesn't cover sending it to Pree. She's an account manager on the Central team, so mailing her the rate needs June's or Anselm's approval.

- **What I did:** I messaged June asking her to approve it, and logged the request as pending.
- **What happens next:** Once June or Anselm says yes, I'll save the "Thornbury 2027 rate" draft to Pree in your mailbox. I won't send it; you'll send it yourself.
